<action type="say">
If you’re signed in and don’t see the personal loan listed at all, there are a few likely possibilities and quick checks:

1) Check for hidden/filtered accounts  
- Look for any **“Show all accounts,” “Hidden/closed accounts,” or filter icon** on the Accounts/Summary page.  
- If there’s a **Loans** tab or dropdown, click it and see if the loan appears there.  

2) Confirm you’re in the right profile  
- If you’ve ever had a **business login** or a **joint login** separate from your personal one, the loan might be under that other profile.  
- Also check if you recently **changed usernames**; sometimes older loans remain linked to the original login until support updates it.

If you still don’t see it, the loan likely isn’t linked properly to your online banking, or it may be in a special servicing status (e.g., very new, very old/paid off, or in collections).

To get your current balance right now, you’ll need to contact the bank directly. Have this ready when you do:

- Your **full name** and **last 4 of SSN** (or whatever ID they use)
- **Approximate origination date** of the loan
- **Approximate original loan amount**
- Any **loan/account number** from a statement (even partial)

Then do one of these:
- **Call the customer service/loans number** on your debit card or any bank statement and say:  
  “I have a personal loan that isn’t showing in online banking. I need my current balance and I’d like it linked to my online profile.”
- Or **visit a branch** with photo ID and ask for the same.

If you tell me whether you have a recent **paper or email statement** for the loan (or any partial loan number you see on it), I can tell you exactly what to quote when you call or go to the branch.</action>
